findings.finding: An at-the-market program of up to $300M with H.C. Wainwright (3% commission), dated 2026-08-19 on an effective F-3 (333-287428, $500M base), is open and can sell stock into any bounce on 2026-10-13. That is about 39% of the ~$770M market cap, from an issuer that added 30.56M shares (+38%) in an August registered direct.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM sells daily through the agent with no further filing needed, so supply can hit the tape in the 2026-10-13 session itself. Sales are only disclosed later (10-Q/prospectus), so the market cannot see whether the issuer used the 195% run and is still selling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-08-10 registered direct (424B5 2026-08-10) and the 2026-08-21 ATM 424B5, the baseline records no >13.5% drop until 2026-09-08 (-13.8%, next close -11.4%). ORTEX reports the late-August print fell 7.7% day one and 16.7% by day five. No direct sample of an ATM-driven next-session move.
findings.why_not_priced: The fall priced the unwind of a sympathy bid, not the issuer as a seller. A rebound tomorrow would meet agent supply that the tape cannot see. If this were priced, the name would trade below its own comparable-fall history (median next close +4.8%), not in line with it.
findings.independence: The 424B5 of 2026-08-21 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1527762/000149315226039602/form424b5.htm) confirms the $300M size, 110,003,800 shares outstanding and the August registered direct. The issuer's history of repeated equity raises (8-K 2026-03-02 item 3.02, Dec 2025 private placement) points the same way.
